title: Workday Systems Analyst – Finance
description:
The Workday Systems Analyst - Finance supports the design, configuration, delivery, and ongoing management of Workday Financials and related finance applications. This role partners with Finance stakeholders to translate business needs into practical system solutions, improve business processes, and maintain reliable reporting and integrations. The analyst provides production support and contributes to projects that improve the efficiency, accuracy, and scalability of Finance operations.
Responsibilities:

• Support Workday Financials and related finance applications, including financial management, procurement, reporting, and connected business processes.

• Partner with Finance stakeholders to gather, analyze, and document business needs, requirements, and functional specifications.

• Evaluate current processes and workflows, identify gaps and inefficiencies, and recommend improvements that support Finance priorities.

• Configure and maintain Workday business processes, security-related requirements, reports, calculated fields, and other functional components within the role’s scope.

• Support project planning and delivery for Finance systems initiatives, including requirements, process design, testing, documentation, and implementation activities.

• Stay current on Workday releases, product capabilities, and relevant finance systems practices; identify opportunities to use new functionality to improve business processes.

• Create and maintain functional documentation, procedures, job aids, and support materials.

• Build effective working relationships with Finance, Accounting, Procurement, FP&A, and other cross-functional partners.

• Minimum of 5 years of experience supporting Finance organizations, Finance systems, business applications, or a related area.

• At least 3-4 years of hands-on experience with Workday Financials or comparable ERP finance modules.

• Working knowledge of Finance processes, procedures, and policies, with the ability to translate business requirements into system solutions.

• Experience with requirements gathering, process analysis, gap analysis, functional design, system configuration, testing, reporting, and documentation.

• Experience troubleshooting system issues and communicating clear, actionable resolutions to business stakeholders.

• Strong analytical, problem-solving, organizational, and customer-service skills.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to facilitate discussions with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• Ability to manage multiple priorities, work independently, meet deadlines, and adapt effectively to change.

Preferred Qualifications:

• Experience with Workday procurement, expenses, accounting, reporting, or related Finance functionality.

• Experience supporting integrations or data flows between Workday and adjacent finance applications.

• Experience with Workday reporting, business processes, calculated fields, and data validation.

• Experience working in a healthcare, technology, or other complex operating environment.

• Experience supporting enterprise software releases, implementations, or continuous improvement initiatives.

title: Vulnerability Defense Software Engineer, Cloudforce One
description:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Available Locations: Austin,TX and Washington, D.C.

Role Summary

Cloudforce One is Cloudflare’s threat operations and research team, responsible for identifying and disrupting cyber threats ranging from sophisticated cyber criminal activity to nation-state sponsored advanced persistent threats (APTs).  Cloudforce One works in close partnership with external organizations and internal Cloudflare teams, continuously developing operational tradecraft and expanding ever-growing sources of threat intelligence to enable expedited threat hunting and remediation.  Members of Cloudforce One are at the helm of leveraging an incredibly vast and varied set of data points that only one of the world’s largest global networks can provide.  The team is able to analyze these unique data points, at massive scale and efficiency, synthesizing findings into actionable threat intelligence to better protect our customers.

As a Software Engineer on this team, you build and evolve systems that help security practitioners assess technical risk, investigate complex systems, prioritize issues, and deliver actionable guidance to engineering teams. You will be responsible for translating complex security requirements and investigative methods into robust, scalable, and high-performance applications that have a direct impact on making the internet better, safer, and more powerful every day.

While the majority of our services are now written in Go and TypeScript, you will also work with technologies such as Rust, Kafka, Redis, Kubernetes, Terraform, and PostgreSQL. We also pride ourselves in dogfooding our own products and services so you will be extensively working with Cloudflare’s developer platform as well. We are looking for great engineers regardless of experience with any of these specific technologies.

Responsibilities include:

• Design, build, run, and scale distributed tools and services that translate security tradecraft into scalable, evidence-based systems and workflows.

• Improve system design and architecture to ensure stability, performance, and maintainability of both internal and customer-facing services.

• Analyze, communicate, and help prioritize complex technical concepts across teams.

title: Configuration Specialist
description:

DecisionPoint seeks a Configuration Specialist to support enterprise Configuration Management (CM) operations for a large federal and DoD-aligned mission environment. This role ensures CMDB accuracy, updates configuration item (CI) records, manages asset relationships, supports CM audits, and maintains data integrity across baselines and operational environments.
The Configuration Specialist will work closely with the CM Lead, cybersecurity teams, DevSecOps engineers, system administrators, and the PMO to maintain accurate, up-to-date configuration data that supports compliance, audit readiness, and secure system operations.
This position is fully remote.

• Manage CI relationships, attributes, and lifecycle data to ensure traceability across systems.

• Support CM audits, CI verification activities, and reconciliation tasks.

• Identify and correct discrepancies, outdated data, or misaligned CI attributes.

• Update baselines and document configuration changes in alignment with CM governance processes.

• Coordinate with the CM Lead on configuration control workflows, documentation updates, and process improvements.

• Work with cybersecurity and ISSM teams to ensure CI data aligns with RMF artifacts and control requirements.

• Support inventory tracking, asset management, and system configuration validation efforts.

• Assist release and DevSecOps teams with configuration-related information needed for deployments or pipeline activities.

• Produce reports, CI summaries, and data extracts for technical teams and government stakeholders.

• Maintain CM documentation, SOPs, diagrams, and CI attribute definitions.

• Support efforts to reduce configuration drift and strengthen data integrity across environments.

•

Experience (Required)

• Experience updating CI records and maintaining CMDB accuracy.

• Experience participating in CM audits, CI reconciliation, or baseline validation.

• Experience supporting configuration governance, documentation, or asset tracking processes.

• Experience collaborating with engineering, cybersecurity, or operations teams on CI-related tasks.

• Strong understanding of configuration management principles and CI lifecycle processes.

Skills

• Strong attention to detail for managing configuration data and identifying discrepancies.

title: Research Scientist / Engineer – Reinforcement Learning Infrastructure
description: You'll build the systems that make reinforcement learning work at frontier scale - coupling policy optimization with large fleets of inference workers, agentic environments, and the reward and verification systems that turn model behavior into learning signal. RL is how Luma's models go from capable to useful. RL at scale is a full-loop systems problem: training, rollout generation, environment execution, and reward computation running concurrently across thousands of GPUs, all needing to stay fast, stable, and correct together. It fits someone who has lived this - post-trained LLMs with RL, built environments and verifiers, and debugged asynchronous rollout pipelines at scale. If you haven't operated RL at real scale, this will be deep water. What You'll Own Design, build, and scale distributed RL post-training systems, orchestrating trainer, rollout, environment, and reward workloads across thousands of GPUs. Build high-throughput rollout generation, integrating inference engines (vLLM, SGLang), weight synchronization, and asynchronous/off-policy schemes. Design RL environments for agentic, multi-step tasks - sandboxed code execution, tool use, computer use, multimodal interaction - reproducible and scalable to millions of episodes. Build reward infrastructure: verifiable/programmatic rewards, reward-model serving, LLM-as-judge pipelines, and defenses against reward hacking. Develop the evaluation, monitoring, and debugging tooling that keeps large RL runs stable. Advance training efficiency and stability, and turn new post-training ideas into production runs with researchers.

• Lead the technical investigation, containment, remediation, recovery, and documentation of information security incidents, partnering with Legal on regulatory, contractual, privacy, privilege, and notification requirements.

The Data Validation Specialist checks that data entering and moving through our systems is accurate, complete, and consistent. The Data Validation Specialist is responsible for labeling, tagging, categorizing, and reviewing large volumes of structured and unstructured data (text, images, audio, video, or multimodal content) according to detailed project guidelines. This role also validates work completed by other annotators, identifies inconsistencies or errors, and provides feedback to improve annotation quality and guideline clarity. The ideal candidate is meticulous, comfortable with repetitive, detail-oriented work, able to follow complex and evolving instructions precisely, and confident flagging ambiguity rather than guessing. As a flex position, the role scales hours up during peak periods such as new AI model launches and down when volume is lower. Assignments are checked to verify progress, through a reporting mechanism by the Artificial Intelligence Project Manager. What would you do in this role?
DUTIES AND TASKS, including but not limited to the following:

Seeks minimum guidance on the following tasks:

• Label, tag, transcribe, segment, or categorize data (text, images, video, audio, or sensor data) according to project-specific style guides and taxonomies.

• Apply bounding boxes, polygons, keypoints, or segmentation masks to visual data as required by computer vision projects.

• Maintain consistent labeling speed while meeting or exceeding minimum throughput targets without sacrificing accuracy

• Review annotations completed by peers or vendor teams for accuracy, completeness, and adherence to guidelines.

• Identify systematic errors, edge cases, and ambiguous instructions; escalate patterns to team leads or guideline owners.

• Perform spot-checks and full audits on annotated datasets prior to delivery or model training.

• Track and report quality metrics (accuracy rate, error rate, agreement rate, throughput) using internal tools or spreadsheets.

• Re-annotate or correct flagged data points and document rationale for changes.

• Provide structured feedback on annotation guidelines, identifying gaps, contradictions, or unclear edge cases.

• Participate in calibration sessions to align understanding of labeling standards across the team.

• Help pilot new annotation tasks, test draft guidelines on sample data, and report findings before full-scale rollout.

• Document recurring edge cases and contribute examples to internal knowledge bases or FAQs.

• Work within annotation platforms to complete assigned tasks.

• Track task assignments, deadlines, and completion status in project management tools.

• Maintain strict confidentiality and data handling protocols, especially with sensitive, proprietary, or personally identifiable data.

• Communicate blockers, ambiguous cases, or technical issues promptly to team leads.

Dzień zaczynamy od sprawdzenia zmian w procedurach, by zawsze być na bieżąco. Następnie udzielamy wsparcia klientom, łącząc rozmowy telefoniczne z zadaniami back-office, a w trudniejszych sytuacjach zawsze możemy liczyć na pomocną dłoń Team Leadera.

W Transcom jesteśmy nieustannie zaangażowani w relacje między sobą i naszymi klientami. Doceniamy ciężką pracę, grę zespołową i wzajemną pomoc, wspieramy pozytywne i trwałe zmiany. title: Impact Fee & Housing Nexus Study Consultant
description:
AlphaGov is seeking an Impact Fee & Housing Nexus Study Consultant to prepare technical analyses and fee recommendations for a local government engagement. You will evaluate how new development affects public infrastructure and housing demand, document the basis for proposed fees, and support the client through review and adoption.
This engagement requires direct experience developing defensible studies that connect development impacts, documented needs, and proposed fees under applicable state requirements.
What you’ll do

• Review existing fee programs, development forecasts, capital improvement plans, housing data, and relevant prior studies.

• Coordinate with planning, finance, public works, housing staff, and legal counsel to establish study assumptions and requirements.

• Analyze infrastructure needs attributable to new development and distinguish them from existing deficiencies.

• Prepare housing nexus analyses connecting the development types under study to associated housing demand.

• Develop transparent calculation models, allocation methods, and proposed fee schedules with supporting documentation.

• Evaluate applicable credits, offsets, and alternative funding sources to avoid double counting.

• Prepare draft and final reports explaining the methodology, findings, fee recommendations, and implementation options.

• Present findings to staff, stakeholders, and governing bodies, and address technical questions during review and adoption.

Requirements

• Direct experience preparing development impact fee studies, housing nexus studies, or both for local governments.

• Experience applying the relevant state’s requirements to study methodology and documentation.

• Strong quantitative skills in development forecasting, infrastructure cost allocation, housing analysis, and fee modeling.

• Ability to distinguish the maximum fee supported by the analysis from the fee a jurisdiction may choose to adopt.

• Experience working with municipal staff and legal counsel to address technical review comments.

• Clear technical writing and public presentation skills.

Experience supporting fee adoption and subsequent updates is preferred.
Benefits
Submit your résumé and a brief summary of comparable studies. Identify the jurisdictions and states, study types, your responsibilities, and whether the studies supported adopted fee programs.

title: Spontanansökan - Sjuksköterska i psykiatri
description:
Om Nova Psykiatri
Nova Psykiatri grundades med en vision om att revolutionera psykiatrin och behandling av psykiska ohälsa. Vi strävar efter att erbjuda en modern och patientcentrerad vårdupplevelse. Vi vill erbjuda bästa Europas bästa utredning och behandling för personer med ADHD, Autism och annan psykiatrisk problematik.
Dagens psykiatri präglas av traditionella metoder och ett ofta långsamt arbetssätt, där tekniska framsteg och patientens behov sällan står i fokus. Många patienter har svårt att navigera i ett komplext offentligt system eller vänder sig till stora vårdgivare där de riskerar att bli en anonym siffra i mängden. Vi har valt att göra saker annorlunda genom att sätta patienten i centrum och erbjuda psykiatrisk vård med en femstjärnig service. Vår strategi bygger på patientupplevelse, kvalitet och effektivitet, där vi använder modern teknik och innovativa arbetsmetoder för att ständigt förbättra och utveckla vår verksamhet.
Vårt engagerade team är kärnan i vår verksamhet och består främst av psykologer, läkare och sjuksköterskor. Nova Psykiatri grundades i januari 2024 och har idag 70+ medarbetare - och vi växer snabbt. Nu söker vi fler drivna personer som vill vara med och forma framtidens psykiatri tillsammans med oss. Vi lägger mycket fokus på att anställa Sveriges duktigaste medarbetare, men även att folk ska trivas bättre här än någon annanstans.

Novas vision är att visa hur psykiatri kan fungera, för såväl patienter som för medarbetare. Vi tror det går att göra mycket bättre. Vi drivs av att hela tiden förbättra patientnöjdheten, hålla hög kvalitet, och samtidigt höja effektiviteten genom minskad administration. Vi tror att vi når allt detta genom att ha kul tillsammans, våga göra misstag, samt genom att våga sträva mot att vara bäst på det vi gör.
Om rollen
Vi är ett företag i tillväxt med ett fortlöpande behov av att rekrytera fler duktiga sjuksköterskor som vill bidra till en förstklassig patientupplevelse. Just nu har vi ingen öppen tjänst, men skicka gärna in din ansökan redan i dag så hör vi av oss när det blir dags igen! Vi söker dig som har erfarenhet av insättning och uppföljning av CS-medicinering och som vill bli en del av vårt engagerade team. Arbetet sker på distans från valfri plats i Sverige, där du får möjlighet att arbeta flexibelt och planera dina arbetsveckor på ett sätt som passar dig.
Vem vi söker

• Sjuksköterska inom psykiatri.

• Meriterande om du har erfarenhet av insättning och uppföljning av CS-medicinering.

• Trivs med att arbeta självständigt och som värdesätter frihet under ansvar.

• Vi letar efter dig som är intresserad av att kombinera effektivitet, kvalitet och patientnöjdhet i ditt arbete. Du är även driven, gillar att utvecklas och öppen för förändringar. Du ser patienten som någon vars förväntningar du alltid vill försöka överträffa, och du vill hela tiden förbättras.

• Vi söker en sjuksköterska i psykiatri som kan möta och behandla en bred patientbas. Vår verksamhet är inriktad på flera patientgrupper som inkluderar barn, ungdomar och vuxna.

Vad vi erbjuder

• Möjlighet att få vara med på en spännande företagsresa mot att ha Sveriges nöjdaste patienter och anställda.

• Stor grad av frihet och eget ansvar.

• Flexibla arbetstider. Möjlighet att lägga upp arbetsveckorna på ett sätt som passar dig.

• Ett administrativt team som avlastar dig med mycket av det administrativa i arbetet, så att du kan fokusera så mycket som möjligt på arbetet med patienterna.

• Var med och påverka och förbättra verksamheten. Förbättringsidéer uppmuntras starkt.

title: Fall/Spring Constitutional Litigation Internships
company: Americans United for Separation of Church and State
description:
Americans United for Separation of Church and State is seeking fall and spring legal interns who are committed to civil rights, impact litigation, and upholding core First Amendment protections. Both part-time and full-time positions are available.
About Americans United. Americans United is a nonpartisan educational and advocacy organization dedicated to advancing the constitutional principle of church-state separation as the only way to ensure freedom of religion, including the right to believe or not believe, for all of us. Founded in 1947, Americans United is a diverse and dynamic organization composed of people from all walks of life: lawyers and lobbyists, students and activists, religious leaders and impassioned Americans. Americans United includes people of faith and people who don’t profess any particular faith.
For nearly 80 years, we have litigated church-state issues in federal and state courts across the country, with a substantial practice before the federal courts of appeals and the U.S. Supreme Court. Most of our cases involve novel, cutting-edge First Amendment and other constitutional issues. In recent years, for example, we have litigated lawsuits and submitted amicus briefs challenging or opposing:

• Coercive religious practices in the public schools.

• Proselytizing by Trump-Vance Administration officials.

• Public funding of religious education.

• Religion-based refusals by businesses, foster-care agencies, and government officials to provide services to LGBTQ+ people and religious minorities. 

• Religion-based efforts to deprive people of access to abortion and contraceptives. 

• Race-based and sex-based employment discrimination by religious employers.

For more information about Americans United’s legal program, please visit our website at .
Duties and responsibilities. Legal interns receive substantive legal experience with in-depth exposure to some of the most important issues facing the nation. title: Director, Accounting
description:
Mission Lane is combining the power of data, technology, and exceptional service to pave a clear way forward for millions of people on the path to financial success. By attracting top talent and leveraging cutting-edge technology, we’re enabling people to unlock real financial progress. Sound like a mission you can get behind?

We’re looking for a Director, Accounting to own day-to-day accounting and treasury operations, reporting to the Controller.
The impact you’ll make:
A Mission Lane customer trusts that when they make a payment, it’s recorded right, that their balance reflects reality, and that the company behind their card is solid enough to keep showing up for them next month and the month after that. None of that happens on its own. It’s built close by close, reconciliation by reconciliation, by an accounting team getting the details exactly right. The Director, Accounting owns that foundation, keeping the numbers behind every customer’s progress ready to stand up to scrutiny.
In your first year, you’ll take full operational ownership of the day-to-day close and treasury accounting, tightening the close calendar and refining internal controls, audit readiness, and AI-enabled workflows toward IPO readiness demands. You’ll do that by:

• Leading the month-end close, from pre-close prep through balance sheet reconciliations and flux analysis, shrinking the calendar as you progress

• Owning the monthly consolidation across our multi-entity structure, keeping intercompany eliminations clean and GAAP compliance airtight

• Directing the annual financial statement audit as our primary external liaison, managing the PBC list and keeping the whole lifecycle on schedule

• Serving as the go-to partner for our external tax advisors and for Treasury on settlement accounting, restricted cash classifications, and reserve calculations

• Bringing AI agents into journal entries, reconciliations, and variance reporting, turning the close into something faster and sharper rather than just another deadline

• Building and developing a small, high-performing accounting team, working alongside them as a player-coach rather than directing from a distance

You’ll thrive in this role if:

• You’ve run a multi-entity close from the inside and know exactly where the friction points hide.

• You get real satisfaction from turning a messy reconciliation into a clean one, and from teaching someone else how to do the same.

• You can lead a team through real process and culture change without losing their trust, even when the change touches how they’ve worked for years.

• You see AI as a way to make your team’s work better, not a threat to it, and know how to bring skeptics along.

Minimum Qualifications:

• Active CPA and a Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field

• 10+ years of progressive accounting and financial management experience, including 5+ years leading a team

• Deep, hands-on experience with month-end close, financial consolidation, and GAAP compliance in a multi-entity organization

• Direct experience leading external financial statement audits end to end, including PBC management

• Working knowledge of the COSO framework and PCAOB standards related to ICFR, with experience designing and testing internal controls

• Proficiency with NetSuite or a comparable enterprise ERP, plus advanced Excel

Preferred Qualifications:

• Experience in financial services, consumer lending, or credit card issuing and servicing, especially with sponsor bank models, card networks, or payment processors

• Experience with Snowflake, SQL, or a BI tool like Tableau

• A track record of bringing AI or automation into accounting workflows

Compensation:
Annual full-time starting base salary range: $158,000 - $213,000
This role is eligible for additional compensation in the forms of participation in our annual incentive and equity programs.
Pay is based on factors such as work experience, education, certification(s), training, skills,

title: Research Engineer / Research Scientist, Human Flourishing
description:
About the Team

The Human Flourishing team’s mission is to ensure AI systems understand and advance human flourishing. As AI becomes more capable and plays a larger role in people’s lives, we want its human benefits to grow with its capabilities. The Human Flourishing team is part of the broader Personal AGI organization.

Our approach has two parts. Firstly, we measure and improve models’ understanding, capability, and propensity to act according to people’s values and to help them achieve their long-term goals. Secondly, we directly scale tangible impact for users in human domains like education and mental health, working across research, product, and partnerships to increase the benefits over a billion people experience weekly when they use ChatGPT.

Our recent work includes Beneficial RL https://alignment.openai.com/beneficial-rl/, which investigates how training for beneficial behavior generalizes across settings, and MentalHealthBench https://openai.com/index/introducing-mentalhealthbench/, a benchmark developed with mental health experts to evaluate realistic conversations.

About the Role

We’re looking for an exceptional, hands-on researcher to turn difficult-to-define signals of long-term flourishing into measurable improvements in model behavior. You’ll help set research direction, build what is needed to test your ideas, and drive successful work into the models and products we ship.

We’re especially interested in researchers with deep experience improving frontier models through pretraining or reinforcement learning (RL) / post-training, especially on less verifiable problems, or researchers who combine strong LLM skills with deep expertise in domains like education or mental health. Prior experience in these domains is not required.

In this role, you will

- Develop scalable training methods across the training stack that improve how models understand people’s values, support their agency, and help them achieve long-term goals.

- Lead high-leverage research from an open question to a shipped improvement: choose a hard-to-define problem, iteratively define success, run experiments, and integrate into frontier models.

- Build RL environments for difficult-to-verify outcomes, and study whether beneficial behavior generalizes across settings.

- Create evaluations grounded in human expertise and feedback that reveal capability gaps, unintended incentives in RL, and failures that aggregate scores can miss.

- Test whether measures of model behavior predict better learning, wellbeing, and other long-term outcomes, and use those findings to guide training.

- Build new 0→1 capabilities in human domains that may have an increasing impact with upcoming increases in model intelligence and test-time compute.

- Partner with product teams, engineers, partnerships teams, and domain experts to deploy promising methods, measure their effects in real use, and turn what you learn into further improvements.

- Assess AI’s impacts on human flourishing at the scale of over a billion users.

You might thrive in this role if you

- Care deeply about helping AI improve people’s lives, and feel this is a responsibility that comes with increasingly capable models.

- Have an unusually strong research record in pretraining or RL / post-training research, especially in a hard-to-verify area; or combine strong LLM research skills with deep expertise in education, mental health, or a related field of human benefit.

- Are a hands-on builder who can turn ideas into rigorous experiments, write and debug code, and work directly with data and training infrastructure.

- Have the taste to choose consequential problems and actionable steps on the path to solving those problems.

- Take ownership of ambiguous problems and choose methods based on the impact they can deliver, including when the most useful work is unglamorous.

- Care about whether a capability will scale, generalize, and make it into the real world-not just whether it can be sho

The bright side of mortgages

nesto is Canada’s leading digital residential mortgage lender, offering Canadians the lowest rates from the get-go - with total transparency and no haggling.

About Us

As Canada's pioneer in online mortgage lending, nesto is transforming the way Canadians finance their homes. Our mission is to offer a positive, empowering, and transparent property financing experience, simplified from start to finish.

Borrowers benefit from rates that are often lower than those offered by the big banks, along with an exceptional end-to-end mortgage experience powered by best-in-class AI technology. Fast, simple, and fully digital, nesto has been recognized as CLA Lender of the Year for three consecutive years. That's the bright side of mortgages.

Nesto Group

Nesto Group is Canada's leading provider of mortgage technology and financing solutions, with more than CAD $80 billion in residential and commercial mortgages under administration. Trusted by many of the country's leading financial institutions, we combine over 50 years of mortgage expertise with proprietary cloud and AI technology to transform the future of lending.

Powered by our proprietary cloud and AI technology, nesto has become one of Canada's fastest-growing mortgage lenders, gaining market share across direct-to-consumer (D2C) residential lending, the broker channel, and multi-family commercial lending. Recognized as one of Deloitte's Fast 50 companies for three consecutive years, we continue to push the industry forward through innovation, technology, and customer-focused solutions.

Operating through our family of brands- CMLS , nesto , and Nesto Cloud -our mission is to build Canada's mortgage ecosystem of the future and create a true Canadian champion in lending technology and financial services. Learn more at:

Life at nesto

title: Senior Security Engineer - Data Security (DLP & Information Protection)
description:
Role type & Location

• Full time Remote (Work from home) based either Dublin or UK only

• Occasional Travel to Dublin office if Ireland based (Glasnevin) or UK (Oxford) if UK based

Visa

• We regret we cannot offer Irish or UK visa sponsorship for this role
About this Role
You will be the engineer who protects sensitive data at Deciphex
We work in clinical and research digital pathology, so the data includes patient health information, personal data and confidential business and customer data.
You will report to the Principal Engineer - Cybersecurity & DevOps and join a lean, hands-on team where each engineer owns a defined area, with no large support structure.
In your first 12 months, three priorities come first:

• Data loss prevention and information protection on Google Workspace and Microsoft 365: classification, labelling and sharing controls, so sensitive data is shared only as intended.

• Least-privilege access to sensitive data: regular access reviews, and controlled, logged sharing with external providers and customers.

• Security review of the tools, integrations and data flows that touch sensitive data, including flows to on-premises laboratory systems, integrations and workflows, and the data side of our AWS-hosted products.

Our technology environment:

• We are a Google Workspace company that also uses Microsoft services, and our products run on AWS.

• You will work with the native data-protection and audit features of each platform: Google Workspace DLP, labels and context-aware access, Microsoft Purview and SharePoint, and AWS storage, encryption and logging services, alongside the security hubs of each platform.

• We also use dedicated enterprise tools for endpoint protection and email security, and Vanta for compliance automation.

About our DTO Team

• Our Digital Trust & Transformation Office (DTO) brings together the teams that keep Deciphex trustworthy and moving forward: information security, cybersecurity, application security, DevOps, IT, data protection and privacy, AI and AI governance, and operational resilience.

• We work to one aim: our customers, clinicians and patients can trust our systems and the data in them, and our engineers can ship safely and quickly.

What You Will help us with

• This is a hands-on engineering role in our Digital Trust & Transformation Office (DTO).

• The Information Security team and Data Protection Officer own governance, risk and compliance, and rely on YOU as the data security specialist.

• The Cybersecurity Engineer owns identity, endpoints and general security operations, and YOU work together on data incidents.

More specifically;

• You will build and run the technical controls that keep it confidential wherever it lives: Google Workspace and Microsoft 365, our AWS-hosted products, other cloud and SaaS tools, or on-premises.

• Design, deploy and tune data loss prevention and information-protection controls. Set retention, versioning and recovery settings so critical data survives ransomware and accidental deletion.

• Enforce least privilege, run access reviews, fix oversharing, and control and log what leaves the company.

• Keep sensitive data located through discovery and flow mapping. Set encryption and key-management requirements for cloud data stores and verify them. The DevOps team runs the keys and infrastructure encryption.

• Carry out the technical security review of new tools, integrations and AI services before they touch sensitive data. The Information Security team, Data Protection Officer and AI governance decide on risk and approval.

• Support the application security team on app data security, and collaborate with the product and data teams to lead good practice such as access models and logging. Those teams own product controls and anonymisation.

• Monitor data access and movement in audit logs and security hubs

• Lead the technical side of data incidents: scope, contain, preserve evidence and brief the Information Security tea

title: GTM Engineer
description:
About Versapay 🚀

Versapay turns accounts receivable (AR) into a competitive advantage.
Inefficient AR processes slow cash flow and stall growth. Versapay removes friction, unlocks working capital, and accelerates momentum - giving finance leaders the clarity and control they need to drive business forward.

Versapay automates accounts receivable, removing barriers to collecting and reconciling B2B payments. Our solutions connect finance teams, customers, and business systems in one ecosystem to ensure cash flow clarity. With over 10,000 customers and 5M+ companies transacting on the platform, Versapay processes over 110M transactions and $257B annually.
Think you might be the next Veep to join? Read on!!

About the role

Versapay is hiring its first GTM Engineer to remove manual work from the revenue engine, speed up response to inbound demand, and run automated outbound plays for Sales and Marketing. You will design, build and maintain the workflows, integrations and AI agents that connect our GTM systems, with Salesforce as the system of record.

This is a builder role inside Revenue Operations and reports to VP of Revenue Operations. You will own problems end to end: find where reps and marketers lose time, design the fix, ship it, and measure the result. We care about hours given back to the field and faster pipeline, not about how many tools/workflows you deploy.
What you'll do

Speed to lead and inbound orchestration
• Own the inbound path from form fill or meeting request to first rep touch, and cut response time to minutes.

• Build lead-to-account matching, qualification and routing logic, with clear SLAs and alerts when they are missed.

• Design and automate instant follow-up: rep notifications, meeting booking, and context-rich handoffs so reps know who they are talking to before they call.

Automated plays for Sales and Marketing
• In partnership with marketing design signal-based plays, for example website visits from target accounts, product or event engagement, job changes of known champions, and renewal or expansion triggers.

• Turn each signal into an action: a task, an alert, a sequence enrollment or an account brief for the right owner.

• Partner with Marketing on campaign follow-up, event lead processing and nurture handoffs so no lead sits untouched.

Eliminating manual work
• Map where reps, SDRs, marketers and CSMs spend time on low-value tasks, and rank fixes by hours saved.

• Automate CRM hygiene: field completion, duplicate prevention, activity capture and stage-change requirements.

• Build AI-assisted workflows such as pre-call account research, call summaries written back to Salesforce, follow-up email drafts and deal-risk flags.

Data and enrichment
• Improve coverage and accuracy of account and contact data using our current data sources.

• Support the evaluation if we choose a dedicated enrichment and orchestration platform (for example Clay), and lead its rollout if approved.

Systems, integrations and governance
• Support integrations between Salesforce, marketing automation, sales engagement, conversation intelligence and other GTM tools, using APIs, webhooks and workflow platforms.

• Work within Salesforce data-model and change-control standards set with the Salesforce admin team.

• Document every workflow: what it does, what it writes, who owns it and how to turn it off.

What you'll bring

Required
• 4+ years in a technical GTM role such as GTM engineering, RevOps systems, marketing ops engineering or sales ops automation at a B2B SaaS company.

• Deep working knowledge of Salesforce: objects, fields, flows, validation rules, and how lead, contact, account and opportunity data relate.

• Hands-on experience building production workflows in at least one automation platform, such as n8n, Workato, Make, Zapier or Tray.

• Comfort with REST APIs, webhooks, JSON and authentication; able to read API docs and connect two systems without vendor help.

• Working scripting skills in Python

Planned Systems International (PSI) is an Enterprise IT services company who focuses on designing, building, securing, and operating cutting-edge software solutions that drive mission success and operational excellence for Federal Government organizations. We are currently seeking a Cybersecurity SME to support the Tactical Assault Kit/Team Awareness Kit (TAK) Product Center (TPC) in all cyber security efforts across all stages of the software development lifecycle. They will collaborate closely with development teams and site reliability engineers to integrate robust security standards and best practices. These duties will support a product wide road map for cyber security compliance for the CI/CD environment and implementing the same. • The Cyber SME will support Security Operations Center (SOC) activities including monitoring, log analysis, and threat detection.

• Assist in vulnerability assessments and penetration testing under supervision.

• Analyze security events and alerts to identify potential threats and anomalies.

• Support incident response activities and participate in post-incident reviews.

• Document findings and prepare technical reports on security assessments.

• Support federal compliance and security framework assessments (NIST, FISMA, etc.).

• Assist in security policy development and implementation.

• Maintain detailed logs and documentation of all security activities and findings.

Minimum Requirements

• Master's degree in computer science or related technical discipline, or the equivalent combination of education, professional training or work experience.

• Active T5 investigation, with the ability to obtain and maintain necessary security clearances as required for access to classified information.

• Current enrollment in an accredited college or university (graduating within 24 months) or recent graduate.

• CompTIA Security+ certification (REQUIRED) or equivalent.

• Demonstrated knowledge of cybersecurity fundamentals.

• Strong written and oral communication skills.

• Willingness to work in a federal/DoD environment with security protocols.

Desired Qualifications

• Enrolled for a PhD in a Computer Science field.

• Active or previous federal/DoD security clearance.

• Prior internship or professional experience in cybersecurity.

• Knowledge of SIEM platforms, firewalls, and intrusion detection systems.

• Understanding of federal security frameworks (NIST, FISMA, FedRAMP).

• Experience with threat intelligence and threat hunting.

• Linux/Unix and Windows system administration experience.

• Basic Python or other scripting language proficiency.

• Additional certifications (CEH, CISSP, CCNA Security, etc.).

• Demonstrated leadership or team collaboration experience.

PSI offers full-time, benefits eligible employees a competitive total compensation package that includes paid leave, and options for employer sponsored group medical, dental, vision, short-term and long-term disability, life insurance, AD&D coverage, legal services, identity theft, and accident insurance. We invest in the professional growth of our employees through professional courses, certifications, and tuition reimbursement programs.
